name: PCR
description: Standard PCR for DNA amplification using a thermocycler. Adjust primer annealing temperature and extension time based on your specific primers and target amplicon size.
source_note: General educational template based on widely used PCR workflows.

steps.title: Set up PCR on ice
steps.description: Thaw all reagents on ice. Prepare a master mix if running multiple reactions. Keep everything on ice throughout setup.

reagents.name: Template DNA
reagents.notes: 1 ng–100 ng genomic; 1 pg–10 ng plasmid

steps.notes: Keep polymerase on ice until use. Spin tubes briefly after mixing.
steps.warnings: Avoid freeze-thaw cycles of the polymerase.

steps.title: Brief centrifuge to collect reaction
steps.description: Briefly centrifuge all tubes to collect liquid at the bottom and remove air bubbles.

steps.title: PCR thermocycler program
steps.description: Run PCR in thermocycler. Typical program: initial denaturation (95°C 3 min) → 30–35 cycles of denaturation (95°C 30 s) / annealing (Tm-5°C, 30 s) / extension (72°C, 1 min/kb) → final extension (72°C 5 min) → hold at 4°C.
steps.notes: Adjust annealing temperature to your primer Tm. Adjust extension time for amplicon size (1 min/kb for Taq; 15–30 s/kb for Phusion).

steps.title: Store or proceed to gel electrophoresis
steps.description: After PCR, products can be stored at 4°C short-term or -20°C long-term. Verify amplification by agarose gel electrophoresis before downstream use.
steps.notes: Proceed to gel electrophoresis to verify amplification.
